documents.title: Q3 2026: comparable CIR 66%, comparable operating profit €22.5M
documents.excerpt: Q3 comparable operating profit €22.5M (27.4); NII €31.9M (−6%) on slightly higher financing costs; comparable opex €46.5M (+10%); credit losses €1.5M. Outlook 2026 unchanged: at or slightly above €106.0M.

documents.title: AUM at a record €18.2bn on €124M of Q3 net sales
documents.excerpt: Net sales strongest in Private Banking, with a significant share invested in insurance wrappers; international sales of emerging-market debt funds continued to grow; resources strengthened in the DACH region.

documents.title: S&P affirms Aktia's ratings, outlook raised to stable
documents.excerpt: S&P cites resilient strategic execution, the ability to generate returns, strong capitalisation and the stabilisation of leadership — supportive for 2027 funding spreads.

documents.title: Opex €4.4M over budget YTD — three consulting invoices in September (synthetic)
documents.excerpt: IT +€1.6M (Oracle and Snowflake in parallel), personnel +€1.3M, purchased services +€0.9M, marketing +€0.6M. 99.2% of 18,420 invoices linked to a GL line.

documents.title: Life insurance run-off book hit by rising rates
documents.excerpt: Net income from life insurance €20.9M YTD (−8%); risk and unit-linked insurance on plan; run-off result burdened by rising market rates and higher estimated customer compensation. Q4 planned at €6.5M.
